material.acceptance_criteria: Owner confirms the working tree is intentional, or the tree is reset to HEAD for the lib.rs and mode changes. Then commit by explicit path, push, ci-status green.
material.description: git status on main: 65 tracked files modified, 1 untracked. Two kinds of change. (1) 64+ files show mode 100644 -> 100755 with no content change (core.fileMode is true). (2) rust/crates/sim/src/lib.rs on disk drops the mod declarations for persist, transport, triggers, doodads and upgrades (-23 lines, +3), while those files still exist and committed code (Sim::place_doodad, commit c74c47b) depends on doodads. Untracked: assets/Models/* (about 6000 files, 142M). Publishing would push this to main unreviewed; no local build is run under the current settings, so CI would be the first compile. Needed from the owner: is the working tree intentional? If not, restore lib.rs to HEAD and drop the mode churn, then the publish row can run.
material.subject: Blocker: 65 uncommitted tracked files on main look like a half-finished edit and must not be published unreviewed
material.witness: codesearch regex over rust/crates/sim/src/lib.rs: persist and doodads are declared (2 matches) and their files exist. transport, triggers and upgrades have no declaration, no source file and no reference anywhere in the tree. lib.rs is consistent with the files on disk, so the state the row names does not hold. Stale.
material.witness_plan: git status clean on the touched paths; ci-status {sha} green on the pushed head.
